title: Part Library rows can still be ticked and changed with Set category
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entries {Part-A} and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT-01 and -02) are in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered) is another category.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SETCAT).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the checkbox of the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the checkbox of the {Part-B} row.
  5. Click the ⋮ icon at the left end of the table's header row.
  6. Click Set category.
  7. Pick {Category-B}.
  8. Click the button that applies the category (for example Save).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 3 and 4: Both rows can be ticked.
  • Step 5: The menu offers "Set category".
  • Step 8: Both {Part-A} and {Part-B} now show {Category-B} in the Category column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy.
